ghi_chu.mo_ta: Tall, slender, plain obelisk-like pointed shaft on the skyline at the centre. It has no church body and looks like a column. It is the only one of its kind among the skyline towers.
ghi_chu.ly_do: It could be read as the Monument to the Great Fire, built 1671–77 near Pudding Lane. It would not exist in 1666. It may only be a generic church spire, so this is a weak suspicion.
